description: WAVES is the Wind Asset Value Estimation System maintained by a US national laboratory team. It combines ORBIT for offshore wind capital costs, WOMBAT for operations costs, and FLORIS for annual energy production. A user supplies project layouts, turbines, construction and operating assumptions through configuration files; the platform returns lifecycle cost and energy estimates for the selected project. Geographic scope is a user-defined offshore site, and the time horizon follows the project finance assumptions. The repository publishes Apache-2.0 source, examples, a Python package and API documentation. A limitation is that estimates inherit assumptions and version changes in three upstream models; a credible project result needs local wind, vessel, cost and maintenance inputs. WAVES supports offshore wind investment scenario analysis. ORBIT was prepared separately in this G7 review, while the catalogue's model-pypsa covers broader power-system dispatch. No project data or package was installed.
